Title: A customer's participant and contract rows open their detail pages

Step Action: Click the list link of the row on the first customer.
Step Expected: The Participants or Contracts list opens.

Step Action: Click the row link of the row on the first line.
Step Expected: The target page starts to open.

Step Action: Wait for the page to load.
Check the page address and content.
Step Expected: The address is the one of the row and no server error page is shown.

Title: A contract can be exported as a document

Step Action: Click Contracts on the first customer.
Click the export link of the row on the first contract.

Title: The tabulation sign-off page shows its actions
Step Expected: The list of tabulations ready for sign-off opens.
The button of the row is shown.

Step Action: Do not click Authorise or Reject.

Title: Cancel on the tabulation sign-off page returns to Results Sign-off

Step Action: Expand the first row and click View.
Wait for the page to load.

Title: A directory user is created and then removed

Step Action: Search for the configured directory user (E2E_DIRECTORY_USER).
Choose the user, enter a department and click Create User.
Open Remove User, choose the same user and click Remove User.
Check the page after the removal.

Title: A new scheme for the current year is created with its required fields

Step Action: Click Create Scheme for Current Year.
Fill the required fields and choose a value in each required list.
Check the page after the save.
Step Expected: No server error page is shown.

Title: A customer's notes are changed, kept after reloading and restored
Step Action: Open Manage Contracts > Customers and open the first customer.
Change Notes to a unique value and click Save.
Put the original notes back and save.

Title: A pricing plan is renewed for the next financial year
Step Action: Open System Administration and the pricing plan page of the row.
Step Expected: The page opens with a Renew button for the next year.

Step Action: Note the year in the Renew button.

Title: Participant Address Labels search by a partial value lists matches

Step Action: Type the value of the row in the search box of the row.

Step Expected: It does not say There are no Results to Display.
No server error page is shown.
